guidelines: Acme Design System principles. (1) Destructive or irreversible confirmations use Modal. Drawer is for non-blocking secondary content and must never confirm a destructive action. (2) Every form control pairs with a Label; placeholder text is never a substitute. (3) Filters live in a FilterBar and collapse to a stacked form below md. (4) We commit to WCAG AA contrast in both themes.

components.name: Button
components.accessibility: Renders a native button. Focus ring uses color.border.focus. Loading sets aria-busy.
components.avoid: Do not use for navigation; use Link.

components.name: Calendar
components.description: Month grid for selecting a single date
components.accessibility: role=grid, arrow-key navigation, aria-selected on the active day.
components.usage: Embed in a Popover for compact contexts.
components.avoid: Single date only. Does not model a range and has no second value.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Text input bound to a Calendar in a Popover
components.accessibility: Input with aria-describedby for format hint; Calendar is a labelled dialog.
components.usage: Single dates such as a due date.
components.avoid: Exposes exactly one value. No range semantics, no cross-field validation.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Floating container anchored to a trigger
components.accessibility: Focus moves in on open and returns to the trigger on close. Escape closes.
components.usage: Compact overlays anchored to a control.
components.avoid: Not for blocking decisions; use Modal.

components.name: Modal
components.description: Blocking dialog for decisions that need an answer
components.accessibility: role=dialog aria-modal, focus trapped while open, returns focus on close.
components.avoid: Not for non-blocking content; use Drawer.

components.name: Drawer
components.accessibility: Focus moves in on open, Escape closes, returns focus to the trigger.
components.usage: Non-blocking detail or filters on small screens.

components.name: Select
components.description: Choose one option from an enumerable list
components.avoid: Not for continuous or open-ended values such as dates.

components.name: Label
components.description: Accessible label bound to a control
components.avoid: Never rely on placeholder text instead.

components.name: Table
components.accessibility: Native table semantics, th scope, sort state announced via aria-sort.

components.name: Badge
components.usage: Status on a row or card.

patterns.name: FilterBar
patterns.description: Horizontal row of filter controls that collapses to a stacked form below md
patterns.avoid: Keep to four controls; beyond that move to a Drawer.

patterns.name: ConfirmDialog
patterns.description: Modal preconfigured for a destructive confirmation
